OAT-06/S24b.title: Survey dialogs, the follow-up question, Settings feedback, Nursing Home task buttons and the two new cards under axe (recorded)
OAT-06/S24b.detail: Our own accessibility check, record only (A1 / A4 suggestions); same profiles and method as S24a. Open baseline survey (dialog named 'Baseline survey'): '(optional)' grey #90a1b9 on white 2.63:1 (desktop, Pixel 7; not flagged on iPhone 15), no unnamed button; its 18 answer chips are toggle buttons (aria-pressed), not radio groups. Handoff follow-up question (after a real send to a second local account): 'Yes' white on teal 3.66:1 and 'Skip' 2.63:1 on all three; Skip is reached by Tab and is 24 px tall. Settings > Feedback: no serious violation; the rating is a named radio group ('Rating, 1 is not useful and 5 is essential'), 'Rate 1' reached by Tab, 62x36 px; Send feedback stays disabled until a rating is chosen. Nursing Home Post-Round with two open tasks: 4 unnamed buttons (each task's complete box and trash; axe button-name, critical), 21x21 and 17x17 px (under 24) — A1, unchanged. New on 43c38a4f: the 4 PM feedback card has no serious violation (its X is named 'Not now', 26x26 px); the task-reminder card's 'Start survey' has the same 3.66:1 contrast (A4, one more place); the open task-reminder survey has no serious violation and its free text is labelled.
